preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 Form 940 year-end records
preview.body:
Hello,

Please prepare the 2026 Form 940 for HANGS Construction Services LLC as a draft for review. We would like to see the year-end FUTA figures now, with the fourth quarter projected, and refresh them in January when the December payroll is final.

Attached are the Q1 2026 year-to-date wages by employee, the Q4 2026 payroll projection and the 2026 FUTA deposit log. The Q2 2026 year-to-date wages, the Q3 2026 payroll register and the Q1 and Q2 returns as filed are in the client folder from the Q3 reports.

The three October payrolls are final. November and December are projected at scheduled hours and current pay rates, with no overtime. We plan one hire, a laborer for the Weller Street job starting November 16. The December 25 payroll will be paid on December 24.

The Q1 FUTA deposit went through EFTPS on May 1. The payroll system carried the Q2 and Q3 amounts forward because they were under $500.

All of our employees work in Washington. Tomas Arvelo is still paid through accounts payable for concrete finishing at Tideflats Cold Storage; we plan to send him a Form 1099-NEC for 2026.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC
payroll@hangs-gc.example

findings.detail: Tomas Arvelo, an individual, was paid $21,168.00 through accounts payable in Q3 for 504 hours of concrete finishing at $42.00 an hour, working under the HGC foreman at Tideflats Cold Storage, and the client plans to send a Form 1099-NEC. Whether he is an employee is a common-law question for a person; the IRS can also be asked on Form SS-8. If he is, he gets a Form W-2 instead, $7,000.00 of FUTA wages and $42.00 of tax join Q3 (line 16c), and line 3 grows by $21,168.00. The draft reports the payroll as recorded.

messages.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 Form 940 year-end records
messages.body:
Hello,

Please prepare the 2026 Form 940 for HANGS Construction Services LLC as a draft for review. We would like to see the year-end FUTA figures now, with the fourth quarter projected, and refresh them in January when the December payroll is final.

Attached are the Q1 2026 year-to-date wages by employee, the Q4 2026 payroll projection and the 2026 FUTA deposit log. The Q2 2026 year-to-date wages, the Q3 2026 payroll register and the Q1 and Q2 returns as filed are in the client folder from the Q3 reports.

The three October payrolls are final. November and December are projected at scheduled hours and current pay rates, with no overtime. We plan one hire, a laborer for the Weller Street job starting November 16. The December 25 payroll will be paid on December 24.

The Q1 FUTA deposit went through EFTPS on May 1. The payroll system carried the Q2 and Q3 amounts forward because they were under $500.

All of our employees work in Washington. Tomas Arvelo is still paid through accounts payable for concrete finishing at Tideflats Cold Storage; we plan to send him a Form 1099-NEC for 2026.

Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC
payroll@hangs-gc.example

sources.title: Schedule A (Form 940) for 2025: Multi-State Employer and Credit Reduction Information

passages.q: Is Washington a credit reduction state?
passages.a: Credit reduction states for 2025. The credit reduction rate for California is 0.012 (1.2%). The credit reduction rate for the U.S. Virgin Islands is 0.045 (4.5%). ... You're subject to credit reduction if you paid FUTA taxable wages that were also subject to state unemployment taxes in any state listed that has a credit reduction rate greater than zero.

The due date for filing Form 940 for 2025 is February 2, 2026. However, if you deposited all your FUTA tax when it was due, you may file Form 940 by February 10, 2026. ... If any due date for filing falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, you may file your return on the next business day.

1a. One state only. Enter the two-letter USPS abbreviation for the state where you were required to pay your state unemployment tax on line 1a. ... 1b. More than one state (you're a multi-state employer). Check the box on line 1b. Then, fill out Schedule A (Form 940).

passages.q: What goes in line 3, total payments to all employees?
passages.a: Report the total payments you made during the calendar year on line 3. Include payments for the services of all employees, even if the payments aren't taxable for FUTA. ... Compensation, such as the following. Salaries, wages, commissions, fees, bonuses, vacation allowances, and amounts you paid to full-time, part-time, or temporary employees.

passages.q: Must HANGS Construction Services file Form 940 for 2026?
passages.a: You're subject to FUTA tax in 2026 on the wages you pay employees who aren't farmworkers or household workers if: you paid wages of $1,500 or more in any calendar quarter in 2025 or 2026, or you had one or more employees for at least some part of a day in any 20 or more different weeks in 2025 or 20 or more different weeks in 2026.

passages.q: What are the 2026 FUTA rate, wage base and credit?
passages.a: For 2026, the FUTA tax rate is 6.0%. The tax applies to the first $7,000 you pay to each employee as wages during the year. ... The credit may be as much as 5.4% of FUTA taxable wages. If you're entitled to the maximum 5.4% credit, the FUTA tax rate after credit is 0.6%.

passages.q: Do employees' 401(k) deferrals come off FUTA wages?
passages.a: Elective employee contributions and deferrals to a plan containing a qualified cash or deferred compensation arrangement (401(k)). Generally exempt, but see section 402(g) for limitation. Taxable. Taxable.

sources.title: Publication 15-B (2026), Employer's Tax Guide to Fringe Benefits

passages.q: Does Publication 15-B treat health coverage through the cafeteria plan as exempt from FUTA?
passages.a: A cafeteria plan, including an FSA, provides participants an opportunity to receive qualified benefits on a pre-tax basis. ... Accident and health benefits Exempt (except 2% shareholder-employees of S corporations). Exempt Exempt

passages.q: Is Tomas Arvelo, paid by the hour through accounts payable, an employee for FUTA?
passages.a: In determining whether the person providing service is an employee or an independent contractor, all information that provides evidence of the degree of control and independence must be considered. ... If you classify an employee as an independent contractor and you have no reasonable basis for doing so, then you may be held liable for employment taxes for that worker.
